title: Ribosome footprint landscape
description: Forward-strand processed footprint profiles for rich defined and pooled minimal media. A 100-kb genomic window is summarized into 400 contiguous 250-bp bins.
unit: mean published weighted read contribution per base
coordinateSystem: 1-based inclusive NC_000913.2 genome window, positions 1–100,000. Original GEO two-column genome positions are assigned to inclusive 250-bp bins.
processing: Stream published gzipped two-column WIG profiles. For each inclusive 250-bp bin in positions 1–100,000, sum published weighted footprint contributions and divide by 250. Positions absent from sparse input contribute zero. Preserve raw profiles and compute whole-forward-profile totals separately; no cross-library normalization or gene-coordinate inference is applied.
limits: Forward strand only; reverse-strand footprint data are not included.
Raw weighted footprint contributions are not normalized for library depth; direct fold-change claims are not justified.
These profiles measure ribosome occupancy, not absolute protein synthesis rates.
No annotation intervals from NC_000913.3 or another build are overlaid.
